are_you_ok.title: Maps show 35% of Minnesota is experiencing severe drought conditions, most other areas dry
are_you_ok.summary: Continuation of the spreading MN drought; diffuse condition covering much of the state including the metro region, affects daily life broadly.
are_you_ok.description: Minnesota could see some much needed rain overnight, though will likely not reverse the course of a drought that is spreading throughout the state.

conversation_starters.title: Minneapolis amplifies 'Mile of Music' to support independent venues and 'surge' recovery
conversation_starters.summary: Continuation of the Mile of Music support effort; metro-level civic/music initiative, work-safe opener. You could open with: 'Did you catch that the city's doing those Mile of Music happy-hour mini-concerts on the 19th?'

conversation_starters.title: Outfitters welcome return of campers, canoers to Boundary Waters after wildfire closure
conversation_starters.summary: Continuation of BWCA reopening after wildfire closure; recreation recovery story, work-safe opener. You could open with: 'Did you hear the Boundary Waters reopened after the fire closures?'
conversation_starters.description: After it was closed for more than two weeks due to wildfires, canoers and campers are starting to return to the Boundary Waters Canoe Area Wilderness.

conversation_starters.title: More recreational sites reopen in northern MN as fire crews continue containment efforts
conversation_starters.summary: Continuation of northern MN wildfire containment; distant point hazard up-state, so not a check-in for the metro but conversation-worthy. You could open with: 'Did you hear the crews are getting the northern MN fires under control and sites are reopening?'
conversation_starters.description: ​Fire officials said that crews are progressively containing the flames, but are urging people to stay alert because evacuation and closure status can change.
